title: Cisco cuts less than 1% of workforce in latest layoff round
summary: Cisco has carried out another round of job cuts in November, affecting less than 1 per cent of its global workforce, as the networking company continues to realign its talent and investments towards areas of customer demand and long-term business value. The latest layoffs reportedly took place on 18
llm_summary: Cisco announced a fresh round of layoffs on 18 November, trimming less than 1 % of its global staff. The cuts are part of a broader effort to refocus talent and investment on high‑growth, customer‑driven areas that deliver long‑term business value.
